answer: Cross-Epoch Response Fingerprinting. Each identity must answer a small hidden probe set every epoch; replies are scored against that identity's prior-epoch profile, and only scores above a tight tolerance keep it in good standing (a durable vault of signed histories). Because forging stable reply patterns across epochs requires sustained real interaction, an attacker running N puppets pays N full onboarding voyages and continuous per-identity upkeep, and any divergence trips a sable flag that suspends the identity until re-earned.
